description: Numeric regional reference cards: three indicators per species, not survival thresholds.
use_rule: Compare the same indicator, unit, annual aggregation and years. Values describe the historical regional grid cell, not measured physiological tolerances. A difference or an out-of-range value does not establish survival or death.

requirements.label: Average monthly maximum temperature
requirements.aggregation: Annual mean of each month's hottest-day temperature

requirements.label: Annual rainfall
requirements.aggregation: Sum of mm/day × days in month

requirements.label: Root-zone soil wetness
requirements.aggregation: Annual mean (0 = dry, 1 = saturated)

soil_wetness.missing_reason: No matching NASA data for this indicator and location.

requirements.label: Mean relative humidity
requirements.aggregation: Day-weighted annual mean

requirements.label: Mean air temperature
requirements.aggregation: Day-weighted annual mean of monthly means

requirements.label: Dry-season rainfall
requirements.aggregation: Annual rainfall sum over reference months [1, 2, 3, 12]; months selected using only 1981–2014, fixed for all locations.

sapo-dorado.use_rule: Compare the same indicator, unit, annual aggregation and years. Values describe the historical regional grid cell, not measured physiological tolerances. A difference or an out-of-range value does not establish survival or death.
sapo-dorado.absolute_value_caution: Cloud-forest species: the NASA grid cell averages 381 m, far below the cloud forest (around 1,500 m), so absolute temperatures and humidity are several degrees warmer/drier than the habitat. Use the change versus normal, not the absolute value.
